title: Burt’s Bees turns consumer trends into lip-care innovation
summary: Discover how Burt's Bees turned evolving beauty and self-care trends into innovation with new Hydrating Lip Balms and Hydrating Lip Tints in a squeezable format designed for today's consumers.
body_markdown:
The squeezable **[Hydrating Lip Balms](https://www.burtsbees.com/product/hydrating-lip-balm/)** take the trusted Burt’s Bees balm experience – long-lasting hydration, responsibly sourced beeswax and feel-good flavor – and reimagine it in a squeezable tube. The formulas deliver 24-hour hydration in a lightweight, non-sticky texture that absorbs quickly and leaves lips feeling soft and smooth. Available in familiar and fun flavors like beeswax, vanilla bean and pomegranate, the balms give consumers a new way to enjoy the everyday lip care they already love, with a more playful application experience.


The squeezable **[Hydrating Lip Tints](https://www.burtsbees.com/product/hydrating-lip-tint/)** extend that care-first foundation with sheer, buildable color and juicy flavor-inspired shades. Available in Juicy Guava, Strawberry Matcha, Raspberry Sorbet and Mocha Latte, the collection offers a fresh spectrum of wearable shades inspired by the flavors consumers love. Infused with hyaluronic acid and responsibly sourced beeswax, the tints also deliver superior-in-category, 24-hour hydration while helping improve lips’ natural moisture barrier. Unlike traditional stick-format tinted balms, the squeeze-tube format allows for a glossier, more sensorial texture with easy, controlled application on the go. The result is a non-sticky tint that feels like lip care and looks like an effortless beauty boost, giving consumers approachable color without sacrificing the nourishing benefits they expect from Burt’s Bees.


Together, the launches expand Burt’s Bees into a squeezy form that consumers increasingly reach for, especially younger shoppers building more flexible, expressive “lip-care wardrobes.” The squeeze-tube format makes application easy and precise, while creating a more playful experience.
